name: Standard Meeting Notes
description: A standard template for general meetings, focusing on key outcomes and actions.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: Provide a brief, one-paragraph executive summary of the entire meeting.

sections.title: Attendance
sections.instruction: Use only explicitly stated or user-confirmed attendance. Mentioned names, task owners and invitees are not proof of attendance. List present and absent people separately on one line each. Leave unknown lists blank.

sections.title: Key Decisions
sections.instruction: List the most important decisions made during the meeting.

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: List explicitly agreed pending tasks, including tasks with no assigned owner or deadline. Use only explicitly stated owners and deadlines; leave missing cells blank. Exclude suggestions, questions, hypothetical plans and completed work. Keep source evidence outside the report.

sections.title: Discussion Highlights
sections.instruction: Summarize the main topics of discussion, key arguments, and important insights.
